## Data Input
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 10))
count_fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data

file_path <- "flights_cleaned.csv"

keep_cols <- c(
  "Year", "Month", "DayofMonth", "DayOfWeek", "FlightDate", "CRSDepTime",
  "Reporting_Airline", "carrier_name",
  "Origin", "OriginCityName", "OriginState",
  "Dest", "DestCityName", "DestStateName",
  "DepDelay", "TaxiOut", "TaxiIn", "ArrDelay",
  "AirTime", "ActualElapsedTime", "CRSElapsedTime",
  "Cancelled", "Diverted",
  "CarrierDelay", "WeatherDelay", "NASDelay", "SecurityDelay", "LateAircraftDelay", "TotalAddGTime",
  "split", "use_cancel", "use_dep_delay", "use_arr_delay", "use_elapsed"
)

dt <- fread(file_path, select = keep_cols)
```


## Overview: Does Taxi In/Out Time Affect the Delay Time?
```{r}
#| label: dist-prep

active_dt <- dt[Cancelled == 0L & !is.na(TaxiOut) & !is.na(TaxiIn)]

stats_dt <- data.table(
  Phase  = factor(c("Taxi-Out", "Taxi-In"), levels = c("Taxi-Out", "Taxi-In")),
  Mean   = c(mean(active_dt$TaxiOut), mean(active_dt$TaxiIn)),
  Median = c(as.numeric(median(active_dt$TaxiOut)), as.numeric(median(active_dt$TaxiIn))),
  P90    = c(as.numeric(quantile(active_dt$TaxiOut, 0.90)), as.numeric(quantile(active_dt$TaxiIn, 0.90))),
  P95    = c(as.numeric(quantile(active_dt$TaxiOut, 0.95)), as.numeric(quantile(active_dt$TaxiIn, 0.95)))
)

plot_dt <- rbind(
  data.table(Phase = "Taxi-Out", Minutes = active_dt[TaxiOut <= quantile(TaxiOut, 0.995), TaxiOut]),
  data.table(Phase = "Taxi-In",  Minutes = active_dt[TaxiIn  <= quantile(TaxiIn,  0.995), TaxiIn])
)[, Phase := factor(Phase, levels = c("Taxi-Out", "Taxi-In"))]
```

```{r}
#| label: general-hist
#| fig-height: 3.6
#| fig-width: 7.0

ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x = Minutes)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), binwidth = 2, boundary = 0,
                 fill = "#4a7ebb", color = "white", linewidth = 0.25, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(data = stats_dt, aes(xintercept = Median, color = "Median (P50)"), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(data = stats_dt, aes(xintercept = P90,    color = "P90"),          linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(data = stats_dt, aes(xintercept = P95,    color = "P95"),          linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ Phase, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Quantiles", values = c("Median (P50)" = "#2a9d8f", "P90" = "#e76f51", "P95" = "#d62828")) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Taxi-Out and Taxi-In Times (Up to 99.5th Percentile)",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Taxi-Out: Median = %.0f min, Mean = %.1f min, P90 = %.0f min, P95 = %.0f min\nTaxi-In: Median = %.0f min, Mean = %.1f min, P90 = %.0f min, P95 = %.0f min",
      stats_dt$Median[1], stats_dt$Mean[1], stats_dt$P90[1], stats_dt$P95[1],
      stats_dt$Median[2], stats_dt$Mean[2], stats_dt$P90[2], stats_dt$P95[2]
    ),
    x = "Taxi Duration (Minutes)", y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8.5, color = "gray30", lineheight = 1.2))
```

As shown in the distribution histograms, ground taxi operations exhibit strong right skewness across both phases, with pre-departure taxi-out durations substantially longer and more variable than post-arrival taxi-in times. Specifically, departure `TaxiOut` has a median of $17\text{ min}$ and a mean of $19.3\text{ min}$, but stretches to $29\text{ min}$ at the 90th percentile and $35\text{ min}$ at the 95th percentile—indicating that roughly one in ten flights experiences severe runway queuing exceeding nearly half an hour. In contrast, arrival `TaxiIn` is concentrated within a much tighter range, with a median of $7\text{ min}$ (mean $8.2\text{ min}$), a 90th percentile of $14\text{ min}$, and a 95th percentile of $19\text{ min}$. This pronounced distributional asymmetry underscores why departure runway queuing represents a far larger source of schedule disruption than arrival gate taxiing.


```{r}
#| label: delay-cor-table

active_dt[, `:=`(
  ExcessTaxiOut   = TaxiOut - as.numeric(median(TaxiOut)),
  ExcessTaxiIn    = TaxiIn  - as.numeric(median(TaxiIn)),
  TotalTaxi       = TaxiOut + TaxiIn
)]
active_dt[, `:=`(
  ExcessTaxiOut   = TaxiOut - as.numeric(median(TaxiOut)),
  ExcessTotalTaxi = (TaxiOut - as.numeric(median(TaxiOut))) + (TaxiIn - as.numeric(median(TaxiIn)))
), by = .(Origin, Dest)]

active_dt[, ExcessTaxiOut   := TaxiOut - as.numeric(median(TaxiOut)), by = Origin]
active_dt[, ExcessTaxiIn    := TaxiIn  - as.numeric(median(TaxiIn)),  by = Dest]
active_dt[, ExcessTotalTaxi := ExcessTaxiOut + ExcessTaxiIn]

metrics <- list(
  "TaxiOut (Raw)"                     = active_dt$TaxiOut,
  "ExcessTaxiOut (vs Airport Median)" = active_dt$ExcessTaxiOut,
  "TaxiIn (Raw)"                      = active_dt$TaxiIn,
  "ExcessTaxiIn (vs Airport Median)"  = active_dt$ExcessTaxiIn,
  "TotalTaxi (TaxiOut + TaxiIn)"      = active_dt$TotalTaxi,
  "ExcessTotalTaxi"                   = active_dt$ExcessTotalTaxi
)

cor_summary <- data.table(
  Predictor         = names(metrics),
  Cor_with_DepDelay = round(sapply(metrics, cor, y = active_dt$DepDelay, use = "complete.obs"), 3),
  Cor_with_ArrDelay = round(sapply(metrics, cor, y = active_dt$ArrDelay, use = "complete.obs"), 3)
)[, R2_ArrDelay_Pct := round((Cor_with_ArrDelay^2) * 100, 2)]

kable(cor_summary, caption = "Correlation Between Taxi Metrics and Departure/Arrival Delays")
```

Ground taxi durations are virtually independent of gate departure delays (DepDelay, $r = 0.010\text{--}0.042$), yet exhibit a statistically significant positive correlation with final arrival delays (ArrDelay, $r = 0.104\text{--}0.231$). Across operational phases, departure taxi-out (ExcessTaxiOut, $r = 0.200, R^2 = 4.00\%$) accounts for nearly three times the arrival-delay variance of arrival taxi-in (ExcessTaxiIn, $r = 0.116, R^2 = 1.35\%$), identifying pre-departure runway queuing as the primary ground bottleneck. Furthermore, airport-adjusted "excess" metrics consistently outperform raw durations across every phase, with ExcessTotalTaxi alone explaining $5.34\%$ of total arrival delay variance ($r = 0.231$)—demonstrating that congestion exceeding local airport baselines, rather than baseline hub size, directly erodes on-time arrival performance.

```{r}
#| label: delay-cor-plot
#| fig-height: 3.8
#| fig-width: 7.0

cor_plot_dt <- melt(
  cor_summary[, .(
    Predictor,
    `Departure Delay (DepDelay)` = Cor_with_DepDelay,
    `Arrival Delay (ArrDelay)`   = Cor_with_ArrDelay,
    R2_ArrDelay_Pct
  )],
  id.vars = c("Predictor", "R2_ArrDelay_Pct"),
  variable.name = "Delay_Type",
  value.name = "Correlation"
)

pred_order <- cor_summary[order(Cor_with_ArrDelay)]$Predictor
cor_plot_dt[, Predictor := factor(Predictor, levels = pred_order)]

cor_plot_dt[, Bar_Label := fifelse(
  Delay_Type == "Arrival Delay (ArrDelay)",
  sprintf("r = %.3f (R²: %.2f%%)", Correlation, R2_ArrDelay_Pct),
  sprintf("r = %.3f", Correlation)
)]

cor_plot_dt[, Bar_Category := fcase(
  Delay_Type == "Departure Delay (DepDelay)", "Departure Delay (All Metrics)",
  grepl("Excess", Predictor),                 "Arrival Delay (Excess vs. Median)",
  default =                                   "Arrival Delay (Raw Minutes)"
)]

ggplot(cor_plot_dt, aes(x = Predictor, y = Correlation, fill = Bar_Category)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.72), width = 0.64, alpha = 0.92) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Bar_Label),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
    hjust = -0.08, size = 2.9, fontface = "bold", color = "gray20"
  ) +
  coord_flip(ylim = c(0, max(cor_plot_dt$Correlation) * 1.48)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Arrival Delay (Excess vs. Median)" = "#e76f51",
    "Arrival Delay (Raw Minutes)"       = "#2b5c8f",
    "Departure Delay (All Metrics)"     = "#a8dadc"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation of Raw vs. Airport-Adjusted Taxi Metrics with Flight Delays",
    subtitle = "Airport-adjusted 'Excess' metrics (orange) consistently outperform raw durations in explaining Arrival Delay",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Pearson Correlation Coefficient (r)",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10.5) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9.5)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
```

### Model Fitting

```{r}
#| label: model-fitting-and-benchmark
#| fig-height: 4.2
#| fig-width: 7.2
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(lightgbm)
library(knitr)

model_dt <- dt[
  Cancelled == 0L & Diverted == 0L &
  !is.na(ArrDelay) & !is.na(TaxiOut) & !is.na(TaxiIn) & !is.na(DepDelay)
]

model_dt[, `:=`(
  DepHour      = CRSDepTime %/% 100L,
  Is_Major_Hub = as.integer(Origin %in% c("ORD", "DFW", "ATL", "DEN"))
)]

model_dt[, Dataset_Role := fcase(
  Year %in% c(2023L, 2024L) & Month %in% 9:11,                  "Train (Sep-Nov 23/24)",
  Year %in% c(2023L, 2024L) & Month == 12L & DayofMonth <= 20L, "Val-Tune (Dec 1-20, 23/24)",
  Year %in% c(2023L, 2024L) & Month == 12L & DayofMonth >= 21L, "Val-Calib (Dec 21-31, 23/24)",
  Year == 2025L             & Month %in% 9:11,                  "Test (Sep-Nov 25)",
  default = NA_character_
)]

model_dt <- model_dt[!is.na(Dataset_Role)]

train_origin_med <- model_dt[
  Dataset_Role == "Train (Sep-Nov 23/24)",
  .(Origin_Med_Out = as.numeric(median(TaxiOut))),
  by = Origin
]
train_dest_med <- model_dt[
  Dataset_Role == "Train (Sep-Nov 23/24)",
  .(Dest_Med_In = as.numeric(median(TaxiIn))),
  by = Dest
]

model_dt <- merge(model_dt, train_origin_med, by = "Origin", all.x = TRUE)
model_dt <- merge(model_dt, train_dest_med,   by = "Dest",   all.x = TRUE)

model_dt[, `:=`(
  ExcessTaxiOut = TaxiOut - Origin_Med_Out,
  ExcessTaxiIn  = TaxiIn  - Dest_Med_In
)]

model_dt[, `:=`(
  Out_Normal = pmin(ExcessTaxiOut, 0),
  Out_Mod    = pmin(pmax(ExcessTaxiOut, 0), 15),
  Out_Severe = pmax(ExcessTaxiOut - 15, 0),
  In_Normal  = pmin(ExcessTaxiIn, 0),
  In_Mod     = pmin(pmax(ExcessTaxiIn, 0), 10),
  In_Severe  = pmax(ExcessTaxiIn - 10, 0)
)]
```


```{r}
set.seed(628)
MAX_TRAIN_N <- 300000L
MAX_TUNE_N  <- 150000L

full_train <- model_dt[Dataset_Role == "Train (Sep-Nov 23/24)"]
full_tune  <- model_dt[Dataset_Role == "Val-Tune (Dec 1-20, 23/24)"]
full_calib <- model_dt[Dataset_Role == "Val-Calib (Dec 21-31, 23/24)"]
full_test  <- model_dt[Dataset_Role == "Test (Sep-Nov 25)"]

train_sub <- if (nrow(full_train) > MAX_TRAIN_N) full_train[sample(.N, MAX_TRAIN_N)] else full_train
tune_sub  <- if (nrow(full_tune)  > MAX_TUNE_N)  full_tune[sample(.N, MAX_TUNE_N)]   else full_tune
```


```{r}
sample_audit_tbl <- data.table(
  Partition = c(
    "Training (Sep–Nov 2023 & 2024)",
    "Validation – Tuning (Dec 1–20, 2023 & 2024)",
    "Validation – Calibration (Dec 21–31, 2023 & 2024)",
    "Test (Sep–Nov 2025)"
  ),
  Purpose = c(
    "Model fitting & airport baseline medians",
    "Hyperparameter & early-stopping tuning",
    "Conformal 90% prediction interval calibration",
    "Unseen out-of-time evaluation (full scoring)"
  ),
  Available_N = format(c(nrow(full_train), nrow(full_tune), nrow(full_calib), nrow(full_test)), big.mark = ","),
  Used_N      = format(c(nrow(train_sub),  nrow(tune_sub),  nrow(full_calib), nrow(full_test)), big.mark = ",")
)
kable(sample_audit_tbl, caption = "Sample Allocation Across Temporal Partitions (Used vs. Available)")
```


```{r}
eval_model <- function(calib_pred, test_pred) {
  margin90 <- as.numeric(quantile(abs(full_calib$ArrDelay - calib_pred), 0.90, na.rm = TRUE))
  rmse     <- sqrt(mean((full_test$ArrDelay - test_pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  mae      <- mean(abs(full_test$ArrDelay - test_pred), na.rm = TRUE)
  cov90    <- mean(abs(full_test$ArrDelay - test_pred) <= margin90, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  list(rmse = rmse, mae = mae, margin90 = margin90, cov90 = cov90)
}
```


```{r}
# --- Model 1: Piecewise Linear OLS ---
m1_piece <- lm(
  ArrDelay ~ Out_Normal + Out_Mod + Out_Severe +
             In_Normal + In_Mod + In_Severe + DepDelay +
             factor(Reporting_Airline) + factor(DayOfWeek) + factor(DepHour),
  data = train_sub
)
res_m1 <- eval_model(predict(m1_piece, newdata = full_calib), predict(m1_piece, newdata = full_test))

# --- Model 2: Piecewise Linear OLS + Major Hub Interactions ---
m2_hub <- lm(
  ArrDelay ~ Out_Normal + Out_Mod + Out_Severe +
             In_Normal + In_Mod + In_Severe + DepDelay +
             Out_Mod:Is_Major_Hub + Out_Severe:Is_Major_Hub +
             factor(Reporting_Airline) + factor(DayOfWeek) + factor(DepHour),
  data = train_sub
)
res_m2 <- eval_model(predict(m2_hub, newdata = full_calib), predict(m2_hub, newdata = full_test))

# --- Model 3: Pure Gradient Boosted Trees (LightGBM) ---
lgb_features <- c(
  "ExcessTaxiOut", "ExcessTaxiIn", "TaxiOut", "TaxiIn",
  "DepDelay", "CRSElapsedTime", "DepHour", "DayOfWeek", "Month",
  "Reporting_Airline", "Origin", "Dest"
)

all_cats <- list(
  Reporting_Airline = sort(unique(model_dt$Reporting_Airline)),
  Origin            = sort(unique(model_dt$Origin)),
  Dest              = sort(unique(model_dt$Dest))
)

encode_matrix <- function(dt_in) {
  x <- copy(dt_in[, ..lgb_features])
  for (col in names(all_cats)) {
    x[, (col) := as.integer(factor(get(col), levels = all_cats[[col]]))]
  }
  as.matrix(x)
}

dtrain <- lgb.Dataset(data = encode_matrix(train_sub), label = train_sub$ArrDelay)
dtune  <- lgb.Dataset(data = encode_matrix(tune_sub),  label = tune_sub$ArrDelay, reference = dtrain)

set.seed(628)
m3_lgb <- lgb.train(
  params = list(
    objective = "regression", metric = "rmse",
    learning_rate = 0.05, num_leaves = 63, min_data_in_leaf = 100,
    feature_fraction = 0.8, bagging_fraction = 0.8, bagging_freq = 1, num_threads = 4
  ),
  data = dtrain, nrounds = 1000,
  valids = list(val_tune = dtune), early_stopping_rounds = 30, verbose = -1
)
res_m3 <- eval_model(predict(m3_lgb, encode_matrix(full_calib)), predict(m3_lgb, encode_matrix(full_test)))

# --- Model 4: Hybrid (Piecewise OLS + LightGBM Residuals) ---
train_res <- train_sub$ArrDelay - predict(m1_piece, newdata = train_sub)
tune_res  <- tune_sub$ArrDelay  - predict(m1_piece, newdata = tune_sub)

dtrain_res <- lgb.Dataset(data = encode_matrix(train_sub), label = train_res)
dtune_res  <- lgb.Dataset(data = encode_matrix(tune_sub),  label = tune_res, reference = dtrain_res)

set.seed(628)
m4_hyb_lgb <- lgb.train(
  params = list(
    objective = "regression", metric = "rmse",
    learning_rate = 0.03, num_leaves = 31, min_data_in_leaf = 150,
    feature_fraction = 0.8, bagging_fraction = 0.8, bagging_freq = 1, num_threads = 4
  ),
  data = dtrain_res, nrounds = 800,
  valids = list(val_tune = dtune_res), early_stopping_rounds = 30, verbose = -1
)

calib_hyb_pred <- predict(m1_piece, newdata = full_calib) + predict(m4_hyb_lgb, encode_matrix(full_calib))
test_hyb_pred  <- predict(m1_piece, newdata = full_test)  + predict(m4_hyb_lgb, encode_matrix(full_test))
res_m4 <- eval_model(calib_hyb_pred, test_hyb_pred)
```


```{r}
benchmark_tbl <- data.table(
  Model = c(
    "1. Piecewise Linear (OLS)",
    "2. Piecewise Linear (+ Hub Interactions)",
    "3. Gradient Boosted Trees (LightGBM)",
    "4. Hybrid (Piecewise OLS + LightGBM Residuals)"
  ),
  Test_RMSE_Min    = round(c(res_m1$rmse, res_m2$rmse, res_m3$rmse, res_m4$rmse), 2),
  Test_MAE_Min     = round(c(res_m1$mae,  res_m2$mae,  res_m3$mae,  res_m4$mae),  2),
  Calib_90PI_Width = sprintf("±%.1f min", c(res_m1$margin90, res_m2$margin90, res_m3$margin90, res_m4$margin90)),
  Test_Coverage_90 = sprintf("%.1f%%", c(res_m1$cov90, res_m2$cov90, res_m3$cov90, res_m4$cov90))
)
kable(benchmark_tbl, caption = "Comprehensive Model Benchmark on Unseen Test Set (Sep–Nov 2025)")
```


```{r}
base_grid <- data.table(
  DepDelay = 0, Reporting_Airline = "UA", DayOfWeek = 3L, DepHour = 12L
)

p95_out <- as.numeric(quantile(full_train$ExcessTaxiOut, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE))
p95_in  <- as.numeric(quantile(full_train$ExcessTaxiIn,  0.95, na.rm = TRUE))

grid_out <- cbind(base_grid, data.table(ExcessTaxiOut = seq(-10, 40, by = 1), ExcessTaxiIn = 0))
grid_out[, `:=`(
  Out_Normal = pmin(ExcessTaxiOut, 0),
  Out_Mod    = pmin(pmax(ExcessTaxiOut, 0), 15),
  Out_Severe = pmax(ExcessTaxiOut - 15, 0),
  In_Normal  = 0, In_Mod = 0, In_Severe = 0
)]
grid_out[, `:=`(
  Pred_Delay = predict(m1_piece, newdata = grid_out),
  Phase      = "1. Departure Taxi-Out (Runway Queue)",
  Excess_Min = ExcessTaxiOut,
  P95_Limit  = p95_out
)]

grid_in <- cbind(base_grid, data.table(ExcessTaxiOut = 0, ExcessTaxiIn = seq(-10, 40, by = 1)))
grid_in[, `:=`(
  Out_Normal = 0, Out_Mod = 0, Out_Severe = 0,
  In_Normal  = pmin(ExcessTaxiIn, 0),
  In_Mod     = pmin(pmax(ExcessTaxiIn, 0), 10),
  In_Severe  = pmax(ExcessTaxiIn - 10, 0)
)]
grid_in[, `:=`(
  Pred_Delay = predict(m1_piece, newdata = grid_in),
  Phase      = "2. Arrival Taxi-In (Gate Wait)",
  Excess_Min = ExcessTaxiIn,
  P95_Limit  = p95_in
)]

effect_dt <- rbind(
  grid_out[, .(Phase, Excess_Min, Pred_Delay, P95_Limit)],
  grid_in[,  .(Phase, Excess_Min, Pred_Delay, P95_Limit)]
)

b_out_mod <- round(coef(m1_piece)["Out_Mod"], 2)
b_out_sev <- round(coef(m1_piece)["Out_Severe"], 2)
b_in_mod  <- round(coef(m1_piece)["In_Mod"], 2)
b_in_sev  <- round(coef(m1_piece)["In_Severe"], 2)

annot_dt <- data.table(
  Phase = c("1. Departure Taxi-Out (Runway Queue)", "2. Arrival Taxi-In (Gate Wait)"),
  x     = c(12, 12),
  y     = c(-12, -12),
  label = c(
    sprintf("Slope (0–15m): +%.2f min/min\nSlope (>15m): +%.2f min/min\n95th Pct Excess: +%.0f min", b_out_mod, b_out_sev, p95_out),
    sprintf("Slope (0–10m): +%.2f min/min\nSlope (>10m): +%.2f min/min\n95th Pct Excess: +%.0f min", b_in_mod, b_in_sev, p95_in)
  )
)

ggplot(effect_dt, aes(x = Excess_Min, y = Pred_Delay, color = Phase)) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0, xmax = P95_Limit, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            fill = "gray92", color = NA, alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            data = unique(effect_dt[, .(Phase, P95_Limit)])) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray55") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray55") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_text(data = annot_dt, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
            color = "gray20", size = 3.2, hjust = 0, lineheight = 1.15, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Phase, ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "1. Departure Taxi-Out (Runway Queue)" = "#e76f51",
    "2. Arrival Taxi-In (Gate Wait)"       = "#2b5c8f"
  )) +
  labs(
    title    = "Marginal Pass-Through of Excess Taxi Time into Arrival Delay",
    subtitle = "Shaded region marks 0 to 95th percentile excess congestion; holding DepDelay = 0 (Piecewise OLS)",
    x        = "Excess Taxi Duration Above Airport Median (Minutes)",
    y        = "Predicted Arrival Delay (Minutes)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10.5) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10.5),
    panel.spacing    = unit(1.2, "lines")
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: hq-vs-nonhq-quantiles
#| fig-height: 3.8
#| fig-width: 7.2

airport_five <- active_dt[, .(
  Flights = format(.N, big.mark = ","),
  Min     = as.numeric(min(TaxiOut)),
  Q1      = as.numeric(quantile(TaxiOut, 0.25)),
  Median  = as.numeric(quantile(TaxiOut, 0.50)),
  Q3      = as.numeric(quantile(TaxiOut, 0.75)),
  P95     = as.numeric(quantile(TaxiOut, 0.95)),
  Max     = as.numeric(max(TaxiOut))
), by = Airport_Group][order(-Median, -Q3, -P95)]

kable(airport_five, caption = "Taxi-Out Five-Number Summary & Tail Extremes (Minutes): 4 HQ Airports vs. Other Airports")

airport_five[, `:=`(
  Airport_Group = factor(Airport_Group, levels = rev(Airport_Group)),
  Group_Type    = fifelse(Airport_Group == "Other Top-10 Airports", "Non-HQ Benchmark", "Airline HQ Hub")
)]

ggplot(airport_five, aes(y = Airport_Group, fill = Group_Type, color = Group_Type)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = Min, xend = P95, yend = Airport_Group), linewidth = 0.95, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(x = Min), shape = "|", size = 4) +
  geom_point(aes(x = P95), shape = "|", size = 4) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = Q1, xmax = Q3, ymin = as.numeric(Airport_Group) - 0.25, ymax = as.numeric(Airport_Group) + 0.25), alpha = 0.88, color = NA) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = Median, xend = Median, y = as.numeric(Airport_Group) - 0.25, yend = as.numeric(Airport_Group) + 0.25), color = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(x = P95, label = sprintf("Min:%d | Med:%d [%d-%d] | P95:%d", Min, Median, Q1, Q3, P95)),
            hjust = -0.06, size = 2.9, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 72), breaks = seq(0, 50, 10)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Airline HQ Hub" = "#e76f51", "Non-HQ Benchmark" = "#1d3557")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Airline HQ Hub" = "#e76f51", "Non-HQ Benchmark" = "#1d3557")) +
  labs(
    title = "Taxi-Out Full Distribution Range: Four HQ Airports vs. Other Airports",
    subtitle = "Whisker = Min to P95; Box = IQR (Q1–Q3); White bar = Median (P50)",
    x = "Taxi-Out Duration (Minutes)", y = NULL, fill = NULL, color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10.5) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
```

```{r}
#| label: hq-vs-nonhq-airline-quantiles

by_airline_five <- active_dt[Reporting_Airline %in% c("UA", "AA", "DL", "F9"), .(
  Flights = format(.N, big.mark = ","),
  Min     = as.numeric(min(TaxiOut)),
  Q1      = as.numeric(quantile(TaxiOut, 0.25)),
  Median  = as.numeric(quantile(TaxiOut, 0.50)),
  Q3      = as.numeric(quantile(TaxiOut, 0.75)),
  P95     = as.numeric(quantile(TaxiOut, 0.95)),
  Max     = as.numeric(max(TaxiOut))
), by = .(Airline = Reporting_Airline, Airport = Airport_Group)][order(Airline, -Median)]

kable(by_airline_five, caption = "Taxi-Out Five-Number Summary & Tail Extremes (Minutes) by Airline and Airport Group")

panel_order <- c("ORD (UA HQ)", "Other Top-10 Airports", "DFW (AA HQ)", "DEN (F9 HQ)", "ATL (DL HQ)")
by_airline_five[, `:=`(
  Airport = factor(Airport, levels = rev(panel_order)),
  Role = fcase(
    (Airport == "ORD (UA HQ)" & Airline == "UA") |
    (Airport == "DFW (AA HQ)" & Airline == "AA") |
    (Airport == "ATL (DL HQ)" & Airline == "DL") |
    (Airport == "DEN (F9 HQ)" & Airline == "F9"),
    "Home Carrier (HQ)",
    Airport == "Other Top-10 Airports",
    "Non-HQ Benchmark",
    default = "Visiting Carrier"
  )
)]

ggplot(by_airline_five, aes(y = Airport, fill = Role, color = Role)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = Min, xend = P95, yend = Airport), linewidth = 0.85, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_point(aes(x = Min), shape = "|", size = 3.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = P95), shape = "|", size = 3.5) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = Q1, xmax = Q3, ymin = as.numeric(Airport) - 0.26, ymax = as.numeric(Airport) + 0.26), alpha = 0.85, color = NA) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = Median, xend = Median, y = as.numeric(Airport) - 0.26, yend = as.numeric(Airport) + 0.26), color = "white", linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_text(aes(x = P95, label = sprintf("Med:%d [%d-%d] | P95:%d", Median, Q1, Q3, P95)),
            hjust = -0.06, size = 2.55, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 76), breaks = seq(0, 50, 10)) +
  facet_wrap(~ Airline, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Home Carrier (HQ)" = "#e76f51", "Visiting Carrier" = "#5fa8d3", "Non-HQ Benchmark" = "#1d3557")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Home Carrier (HQ)" = "#e76f51", "Visiting Carrier" = "#5fa8d3", "Non-HQ Benchmark" = "#1d3557")) +
  labs(
    title = "Taxi-Out Full Distribution Range (Min, Q1, Median, Q3, P95) by Airline",
    subtitle = "Whisker = Min to P95; Box = IQR (Q1–Q3); White bar = Median; Orange = Own HQ hub",
    x = "Taxi-Out Duration (Minutes)", y = NULL, fill = NULL, color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10.5) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing = unit(1.1, "lines"), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))
```
